title: Check Checkpoint Corruption
description: Check for checkpoint corruption-induced hangs causing 'Jax Process 0 != McJax Coordinator Slice 0' on startup restarts.
instruction: python3 tools/scripts/pull_and_format_logs.py --limit=${limit} --workload_name=${workload_name} --project_id=${project_id} --start=${start} --end=${end} --output_file=${output_file} --filter_extra="\"Jax Process 0 != McJax Coordinator Slice 0\""

output_file.description: Destination for matched entries. Required: the script writes results here, not to stdout.

start.description: RFC3339 start of the run window. Required to reach a historical incident: without it gcloud falls back to a 1-day freshness default and returns nothing.

end.description: RFC3339 end of the run window.
